Gaza Strip Palestinians, mostly children, watch a film screening organised by the Little Wings mobile cinema initiative in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in war-torn Gaza City. The initiative aims to help children experience the magic of cinema and some normalcy amid the widespread destruction.

Kunming, China Pupils showcase handmade hats on the first day of the new autumn semester at a primary school in Yunnan province.
Santo Domingo Xenacoj, Guatemala Catholics take part in a procession to pray for rain amid a prolonged drought.
Mexico City, Mexico A young woman gestures at a remote-controlled robot during an “aura farming” competition, in which people do things to look cool or stylish.

Panama City, Panama A traditional dance during the Casco Peatonal celebrations in Panama City’s Casco Viejo, which transforms the historic district of Panama’s capital into a pedestrian zone every last Sunday of the month.

Gaza 16-year-old Mahmoud al-Durrah in his war-damaged home. He said the loss of a leg in an Israeli shooting had ended his hopes of becoming a professional athlete.
Manchester, England The Manchester Village Pride parade passes through St Peter’s Square as thousands make their way in torrential rain towards the city’s Gay Village.
Buenos Aires, Argentina People protest against Peter Thiel, the chair of Palantir, holding signs telling his company to leave.
Lake Albano, Italy Pope Leo takes part in a boat procession in honour of Our Lady of the Lake.

Aerial view shows buildings buried in mud beside a river after flooding in Nepal.

Kyiv, Ukraine A firefighter walks next to a destroyed warehouse after Russian drone attacks on the outskirts of Kyiv. The foreign minister, Andrii Sybiha, said on Thursday: ‘ Overnight, Russia carried out a massive strike against Ukraine, targeting ports, grain storage, energy, industry and other infrastructure with ballistic ⁠and hypersonic missiles and combat drones’.

Boryspil, Ukraine A member of a mobile fire group engages an incoming jet-powered Shahed drone during a Russian aerial attack in Boryspil. The Ukrainian military said it shot down seven ballistic missiles and 258 drones as Russia carried out a lengthy attack that extended over Wednesday night and well into Thursday.

Boryspil, Ukraine Massive flames and thick smoke rise from burning commercial and food storage warehouses after a Russian drone attack in Boryspil. Russia has said it could retaliate against the UK for its support of Kyiv by striking military targets inside and outside Ukraine , amid reports that the director of the CIA warned the Kremlin against attacking Nato during a secretive visit this week.

Nuwakot, Nepal Rescuers use an earthmover to carry a victim of flash flooding to safety along the Trishuli River in Nuwakot. Nearly 600 people have been killed and hundreds, including large numbers of foreign tourists, are missing after flash floods ⁠hit the Himalayan border areas of ⁠Nepal and Tibet in China.

Nuwakot, Nepal Residents look at the devastation left by flash flooding in Nuwakot . The international community is scrambling to get aid into flood-stricken parts of Nepal and Tibet but search and rescue efforts – including for hundreds of tourists – have been complicated by the destruction of dozens of bridges and miles of roads in the mountainous region, which is popular with trekkers and pilgrims.

Bidur, Nepal People react after the flood disaster at an army barracks in Bidur, where Nepal’s rescue efforts were being co-ordinated. The Red Cross has said at least 93,000 people may have been affected by Wednesday’s flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, which have killed nearly 600 people, left another 1,900 missing, and triggered a huge rescue operation that is being hampered by fears of new flooding.

Trishuli, Nepal A child at Maithali barracks, an army training centre serving as a base for rescued and airlifted survivors. Rescue teams reported finding bodies hundreds of miles downstream in the Chitwan district of Nepal, hundreds of miles downstream.

Gaza Smoke rises after an Israeli attack in Gaza. A witness said the strike targeted the Asqalan prayer hall, which is home to many Gaza residents displaced during the Israeli incursion. More than 100 French and British former diplomats have said Palestine is being erased in front of the world’s eyes and called for urgent action including trade and arms sales bans to press Israel to accept a Palestinian state.

Gaza Palestinians walk past the rubble of collapsed buildings at Jabalia refugee camp in the northern Gaza Strip. Grassroots Labour groups in the UK are gearing up for a conference showdown with Andy Burnham over Gaza, as the party’s members seek to force the prime minister to recognise Israel’s actions as a genocide and impose a full arms embargo.

Jannatah, West Bank Israeli settlers confront left-wing activists in the Israeli-occupied Palestinian village of Jannatah. Violent settler attacks in the occupied West Bank under direct Palestinian rule have almost doubled since 2025, as settlers pursue a self-proclaimed ‘great settlement revolution’ in the very heart of the territory earmarked for a Palestinian state.

Al-Mansouri, Lebanon Smoke rises from the site of several Israeli airstrikes that targeted the area of al-Mansouri. The latest round of war has hardened existing divisions over Hezbollah . The group’s supporters accuse the government of humiliating Lebanon by negotiating directly with Israel and not responding to its attacks. Hezbollah’s opponents blame the group for provoking a war by launching rockets at Israel on 2 March, triggering Israel’s invasion and current occupation.
Kinmen, Taiwan Soldiers attend a ceremony for the anniversary of the start of the 1958 second Taiwan Strait crisis, in Kinmen.

Kampar, Indonesia Police in firefighting gear extinguish a peatland fire at Tambang in Kampar. Indonesia’s unique rainforests are home to peatland ecosystems, which should be naturally resilient to fire when water tables remain high . However, drainage networks built to clear land for pulp and oil palm plantations have robbed the soil of its natural capacity to retain water, experts say.
Qarah, Syria A mine-clearing tank takes part in an operation to clear land mines in Qarah.
Space Astronauts Sophie Adenot from the European Space Agency and Nasa’s Anil Menon work together during a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
Nairobi, Kenya Cosplayer Julius Mokaya poses for a photograph while creating content for his social media accounts ahead of the Otamatsuri convention in Nairobi.
Arendal, Norway Reagan Popoff from the US competes during the døds diving world championship in Arendal.

Costa Mesa, California, US A visitor looks at a mural of Dolly Parton in Costa Mesa. Parton, one of the greatest singer-songwriters in country music , who was also much cherished for her philanthropy, died this week aged 80.

Kramatorsk, Ukraine Oleksandr, a soldier, lifts his bride, Tetiana, a medic, on their wedding day. Getting married in Kramatorsk, Oleksandr says, is a necessary act of memory, because soon there may not be much more left to survive. ‘In this war, all this can just be vaporised, in a few months, in a few days,’ the groom explains immediately after the ceremony. ‘On the battlefield, many cities, towns, small villages where I was two, three years ago, they are now just ruins, just destroyed’.
